summary:
Backend-only testing of updated GET /api/contingency/export (all-applications left-join: 150 apps, 6 columns incl. 'Has Contingency Plan'). Rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_contingency_export.py to the NEW spec (headers, freeze_panes A2, red fill E61A27, row coverage: 150 distinct apps, 37 Yes, 122 No, 159 total, blank fields on 'No' rows, populated on 'Yes'). All 9 tests pass. Regression suite test_contingency_picker.py (11 tests) also passes — /api/products=150, /api/contingency?product=SFA returns 2 rows, multi-process picker endpoints unaffected, render-html countries one-per-line via
. No TEST_/QA_ catalog pollution introduced (only ephemeral draft created & deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py contingency_export: sort key is (platform, name) which the spec doesn't mandate; previous spec was (app, process). Order isn't asserted in the new tests, acceptable.
contingency_export also appends orphan contingency rows whose product is not in the catalog (defensive); currently none exist (all 28 cmap products are in PRODUCTS), so count stays at 159.
seed_data_creation: None. One ephemeral IMCR draft was created and deleted inside test_render_html_countries_newline (cleanup in finally block).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Export now has 6 columns [Platform, Business Application, Business Process, Contingency Plan (Failed System), Owner, Has Contingency Plan], 159 data rows, freeze_panes A2, header fill E61A27. 150 products, 37 cmap rows (28 distinct), 122 apps without plan. Tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_contingency_export.py.
